note: Fresh held-out test set for agent-0.3.x (named concepts, concept-coverage check, 95% intervals). Questions written by an independent subagent from a description of the project and the list of the 158 already-used questions only (not the tools or prompts); expected behaviour, accept, must_not and requires were added by Claude before any run and are not edited afterwards. Results are reported as they come; no change is made to the agent for this set.
